mask.d: An infinite family of actions that keep or remove elements at the top of the stack based on the sequence of dips and lines.
mask.u: This pattern accepts arguments. Use it like this: hexcasting:mask(1100100), where 1 represents a line (keep the element) and 0 represents a dip (remove the element). For example if the stack is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] and you use hexcasting:mask(11010) the stack will become [1, 2, 4]
